gloss_en: I want to send an email to the manager now
notes: [tech] English loan email→imiːl (West Sudanic has no mid /eː/; total nativisation projects to nearest [iː], no drop). English is the tech-register CS layer (with Hausa) in Borno. qaf→[ɡ] داير frame (owens1993). en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

sentence: عِنْدِي laptop جَدِيد بَسّ wifi بَطِيء
raw: عندي laptop جديد بس wifi بطيء
ipa: ˈʕindiː labtub dʒaˈdiːd ˈbass wifi bɑˈtˤiːʔ
gloss_en: I have a new laptop but the wifi is slow
notes: [tech] English loans laptop→labtub (/p/→[b]); wifi→wifi. native جديد→[dʒaˈdiːd] shows Nigerian jīm ج→[dʒ] (owens1993; owens2006). en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: I downloaded a file but the download is slow
notes: [tech] English loans file→fil; download→dawnlaud (/aʊ/→[aw], diphthong retained — Bedouin West Sudanic type; owens1993). en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: I forgot the password of the email
notes: [tech] English loans password→baswuːrd; email→imiːl (no /eː/→[iː]). تاع genitive exponent. en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: I have an important meeting with a manager
notes: [work] English loans meeting→miːtinɡ (/ŋ/→[nɡ]); manager→manadʒar (loan /dʒ/, matching native jīm→[dʒ] in ar-NG; owens1993). en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: I saw a video online
notes: [daily] English loans video→fidiu (/v/→[f]); online→unlin. en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: there are three good offers
notes: [commerce] English loan offers→ufars. INTERDENTAL MERGER: native ثلاثة 'three'→[taˈlaːta], ث→[t] — Nigerian Arabic has fully lost the interdentals, merging them into the stops (owens2006 p.25), the delta from the more conservative Chadian parent (ar-TD) which variably retains θ. en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: I paid cash not card
notes: [commerce] English loans cash→kaʃ; card→kaːrd. ما-negation. en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

sentence: دَا service مَا كْوَيِّس وْ delivery مِتْأَخِّر
raw: دا service ما كويس و delivery متأخر
ipa: ˈdaː sarfis ˈmaː ˈkwajjis w dilifari mitˈʔaxxir
gloss_en: this service is not good and the delivery is late
notes: [commerce] English loans service→sarfis (/v/→[f]); delivery→dilifari. دا demonstrative + ما-negation. en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

sentence: مَا عَارِف بَسّ دَا model غَالِي
raw: ما عارف بس دا model غالي
ipa: ˈmaː ˈʕaːrif ˈbass ˈdaː mudil ˈɣaːliː
gloss_en: I don't know but this model is expensive
notes: [automotive] English loan model→mudil. دا 'this' demonstrative (West Sudanic; owens1993). en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: did you see the manager in the garage
notes: [daily] English loans manager→manadʒar; garage→ɡaːradʒ (final /ʒ/→[dʒ]; onset [ɡ] in inventory via qaf→[ɡ]; owens1993). en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: I looked for the charger but did not find it
notes: [tech] English loan charger→ʃaːrdʒar (/tʃ/→[ʃ], loan /dʒ/ kept). native لقيتو→[laˈɡajtuː] shows qaf→[ɡ] and retained /aj/ diphthong (Bedouin type; owens1993). en-GB donor, default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: I have a new mobile
notes: [tech] loan موبايل 'mobile'; attested [moːbaːjil]. PIPELINE WRONG: emits 'muˈːbaːjl' — reads و as [uː] not the loan mid vowel [oː] and misplaces stress inside the length mark. Correct loan IPA pinned. default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: the car has a puncture
notes: [automotive] loan بَنشَر 'puncture' (< Eng. puncture) → banʃar, matches attested [banʃar] (Holes 2004). Pipeline reads the vocalised loan natively and matches. default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: I paid cash, there are no problems
notes: [commerce] loan كَاش 'cash' → kaːʃ, matches attested [kaːʃ]. ما في 'there isn't' negation. default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: I have a television in the room
notes: [daily] loan تلفزيون 'television'; attested [tilifizjoːn]. PIPELINE WRONG: emits 'tilifiˈzjuːn' — reads و as [uː] instead of the loan mid vowel [oː]. Correct loan IPA pinned. default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: I took a taxi to the market
notes: [automotive] loan تاكسي 'taxi' → taːksi, matches attested [taːksi]. سوق→[suːɡ] shows qaf→[ɡ] (owens1993). default pan-Arabic table (Watson 2002; Holes 2004).

gloss_en: how are you, man?
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Nigerian/Shuwa (7=ح/ħ; zol 'man/person'). Spells كَيْف حَالَك يَا زَوْل؟ Pipeline has no Arabizi path; ipa hand-derived as the Nigerian reading. DIPHTHONG RETENTION: the modelled Bedouin West Sudanic variety keeps /aj aw/ (owens1993), so كيف→[kajf], زول→[zawl] — the delta from urban N'Djamena (ar-TD) which monophthongises. table: n/a

gloss_en: where did you go yesterday
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Nigerian/Shuwa (7=ح/ħ). Spells وَيْن مَشَيْت أَمْبَارِح. Pipeline has no Arabizi path; ipa hand-derived with retained diphthongs وين→[wajn], مشيت→[maʃajt] (Bedouin type; owens1993). table: n/a

gloss_en: do you have anything new?
notes: [arabizi] Latin-script Nigerian/Shuwa (3=ع/ʕ, 7=ح/ħ, j=ج). Spells عِندَك حاجة جْديدة؟ Pipeline has no Arabizi path; ipa hand-derived; jīm→[dʒ] in ħaːdʒa/dʒdiːda (owens1993; owens2006). table: n/a
